## What's new in v2.5.5

### Fixed a crash at launch (#3867)

- Fixes a crash at launch for some people using EnviousWispr in German. The on-screen pill's view resized its own window on every layout, and the longer German text turned that into a loop that macOS stopped with a crash.

### Smoother quitting (#3914, #3940, #3941)

- Fixes a crash at quit after using Whisper or Universal Live Preview. At quit, their models are released, with a fallback exit if cleanup stalls.
- Switching away from Whisper frees its model.
- At quit, the word check drops its model without waiting. The polish output classifier unloads when nothing needs it.

### Pills fit long messages (#3916, #3921)

- Warning, error and status messages in pills wrap across lines at one width, and their action buttons stay on one line.
